## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring / maintenance

## Testing

Describe the tests you ran, for example:

```bash
mvn test
```

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the pull request focused and reasonably small.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I ran `mvn license:format` for Java source changes.
- [ ] I signed off my commits (`git commit -s`) and agree to the contributor license terms in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I updated documentation where needed.
